task_prompt: Put the three hard disk drives into the hard-disk stack on the right side of the computer case
task_summary: One at a time, the right hand picks up each of the three hard disk drives lying in front of the open computer case, slides it into a free slot of the drive cage on the right side of the case, and pushes it fully home with the index finger; the left hand rests.

environment.camera: fixed camera looking down over the table from the operator's side

hands.notes: The left hand rests on the table or holds nothing.

objects.name: black computer case

appearance.chassis: black steel tower lying on its side with the side panel removed, open toward the camera
appearance.drive_cage: black stacked bays on the right side of the case

objects.approximate_size: large, spanning most of the far half of the table
properties: A heavy rigid case that does not move; its open side faces the camera.
On its right side is a drive cage with several stacked horizontal slots; each slot accepts one drive slid in along the slot direction and holds it in place.
Three of the slots are free at the start and filled at the end, one drive each.
objects.initial_state: open case with three empty slots in the right-side cage
objects.final_state: three slots each holding a drive
objects.evidence: prompt: 'hard-disk stack on the right side of the computer case'; the case fills the far part of every frame; drives enter the cage on its right at 6.7 s, 13 s and 20 s.

objects.name: hard disk drive

appearance.body: silver metal rectangular drive in a black tray
appearance.label: white label on top

properties: A rigid rectangular block grasped around its edges with one hand and carried level.
It slides into a cage slot along the slot direction and seats when pushed fully in.
objects.initial_state: lying rightmost of the three drives in front of the case
objects.final_state: seated in the first filled cage slot
objects.evidence: 5.3 to 6.7 s the right hand lifts the rightmost drive; 6.7 to 8 s it enters the cage; 8 to 10 s the index finger pushes it in.

objects.name: hard disk drive

appearance.body: silver metal drive in a black tray

objects.initial_state: lying in the middle of the three
objects.final_state: seated in the second filled cage slot
objects.evidence: 10.7 to 12 s the right hand lifts the middle drive; 12 to 14.7 s it enters the cage and is pushed in; 16 s a final push.

objects.name: hard disk drive

appearance.body: silver metal drive in a black tray

objects.final_state: seated in the third filled cage slot
objects.evidence: 17.3 to 18.7 s the right hand lifts the last drive; 20 to 22.7 s it enters the cage; 24 to 25.3 s it is pushed in.

hand_roles.right: Grasps the drive around its edges and lifts it.

subgoals.goal: Drive 1 is held clear of the table.

subgoals.action: Carry drive 1 to a free slot of the cage and slide it in.

hand_roles.right: Aligns the drive with the slot and slides it in along the slot.

subgoals.goal: Drive 1 is inside the slot, partly or fully.

subgoals.action: Push drive 1 fully home with the index finger.

hand_roles.right: Extends the index finger and pushes the drive's exposed end into the cage.

subgoals.goal: Drive 1 is seated flush in its slot.
Drive 2 is held clear of the table.

subgoals.action: Carry drive 2 to the next free slot and slide it in.

hand_roles.right: Aligns and slides the drive into the slot.
Pushes the drive in with the index finger.

subgoals.goal: Drive 3 is held clear of the table.

subgoals.action: Carry drive 3 to the last free slot and slide it in.

hand_roles.right: Aligns and slides the drive into the slot.
Pushes the drive in with the index finger, then withdraws.

subgoals.goal: Drive 3 is seated flush; all three slots are filled.

task_success: All three drives are seated in the right-side drive cage of the case; nothing remains on the table in front of the case.
notes: The three drives look alike; they are distinguished by their starting position (right, middle, left) and the order they are installed.
